svg.text: A design copilot: client → site → drivers → precedents → massing → space → materiality, held by a per-project spine. Restructured 2026-07-25.
THE METHOD — process flow in true run order
◇ phase-gate critic between phases — “does this still serve the drivers?”
phases loop — the spine keeps looping safe
PROJECT SPINE (read ↑ before every phase · write ↓ after)
brief · design drivers · decision log · open questions · client profile — the memory that keeps early insight alive to late phases
THE TOOLING — reusable machinery, grouped by type
THE ROADMAP — how the tool evolves
✓ DONE 2026-07-25 — Re-packaged Phase 1 · Precedents & Phase 3 · Massing into SKILL.md (true run order); skill rebuilt with the 2 missing references.
1. Decide OQ-18 (single- vs two-storey) → close Phase 4 — pilot space planning tested + PAUSED; verify areas, loop winner to Massing Studio, then fold P4 into SKILL.md.
2. Build Phase 5 · Materiality — palette + pool-humidity / envelope specs + local-trades detailing.
3. Exports (xlsx program · docx brief+drivers · pdf boards) and exercise Library promotion.
4. Optional upload modes — sketch → option, real-drawing precedent overlay (token-taxing, on-request).
